requirements.text: The Library Management System web application must ensure proper functionality of the navbar toggler button on small screens. When the page loads with a window size small enough to hide the navigation menu, the menu should be initially collapsed. Clicking the navbar toggler button (identified by data-testid="navbar-toggler") should expand the navigation menu (data-testid="navbarSupportedContent"), making the menu items visible. If the menu is already expanded, clicking the toggler button again should collapse it, hiding the items.

The system shall allow users to add a book to the library list using the form identified by my-library-form. The form includes three fields: 'User Name' (data-testid="user-name-input"), 'Book Name' (data-testid="book-name-input"), and 'Book Type', which includes the options 'Fiction' (data-testid="fiction-radio"), 'Programming' (data-testid="programming-radio"), and 'Cooking' (data-testid="cooking-radio").Upon clicking the 'Add Book' button (data-testid="add-book-button"), the system shall validate the inputs as follows:
1. If either the 'User Name' or 'Book Name' field is empty, the system shall display an error alert with the message "Oops! Book is not issued".
2. If the entered 'Book Name' has already been issued to another user, the system shall display an error alert with the message "Oops! Book is already issued by [issuedUser]".
3. If all inputs are valid and the book has not been issued, the system shall add the entry to the list, displaying the reader’s name, book name, and genre in the table. A success alert with the message "Success Book is issued" shall be shown.
The system shall also handle edge cases such as unusually long book names and ensure that the list persists across page reloads using local storage.

When the user clicks the 'delete-button' associated with a specific book entry in the table, the system shall remove that book from the list and update the display accordingly. Each delete button is uniquely identified by the data-id attribute in the format 'delete-button-{index}', where {index} corresponds to the position of the book in the list. Upon deletion, the system must ensure the book entry is permanently removed from both the display and local storage, and the table must be re-rendered to reflect the updated state of the book list.

Upon loading the Library Management System webpage, the system must retrieve the list of books stored in the browser's local storage and display them within the table body element identified by data-testid="table-body". If local storage contains one or more entries, each book must be rendered with its full details, including serial number, date of issue, reader's name, book name, and genre. If local storage is empty, the table body should remain empty to indicate no books are currently stored. The data must be stored under the listItems key as a JSON string representing an array of objects, each with userName, bookName, and type fields. For example:
localStorage.setItem('listItems', JSON.stringify([{ userName: 'John Doe', bookName: 'Python Programming', type: 'Programming' }])).
The system must parse and display this data as if it were submitted through the form.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Expand the navigation menu by clicking the navbar toggler button
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Navbar Toggler Button Functionality
  The navbar toggler button should expand or collapse the navigation menu when the window size is small, displaying the menu items when expanded and hiding them when collapsed.


  Scenario: [Normal] Expand the navigation menu by clicking the navbar toggler button
    Given the webpage "Library Management System" is loaded
    And the window size is small enough to hide the navigation menu
    And the navigation menu is initially collapsed
    When the user clicks the navbar toggler button with data-testid "navbar-toggler"
    Then the navigation menu with data-testid "navbarSupportedContent" should be expanded
    And the menu items should be visible

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Collapse the navigation menu by clicking the navbar toggler button again
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Navbar Toggler Button Functionality
  The navbar toggler button should expand or collapse the navigation menu when the window size is small, displaying the menu items when expanded and hiding them when collapsed.


  Scenario: [Normal] Collapse the navigation menu by clicking the navbar toggler button again
    Given the webpage "Library Management System" is loaded
    And the window size is small enough to hide the navigation menu
    And the navigation menu is expanded
    When the user clicks the navbar toggler button with data-testid "navbar-toggler"
    Then the navigation menu with data-testid "navbarSupportedContent" should be collapsed
    And the menu items should be hidden

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Successfully add a book with valid inputs
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Add a book to the library list
  The system should allow users to add a book to the library list by filling out the form with valid inputs.


  Scenario: [Normal] Successfully add a book with valid inputs
    Given the "Library Management System" page is loaded
    And the user enters "John Doe" into the username field with data-testid "user-name-input"
    And the user enters "JavaScript Essentials" into the book name field with data-testid "book-name-input"
    And the user selects the "Programming" radio button with data-testid "programming-radio"
    When the user clicks the "Add Book" button with data-testid "add-book-button"
    Then the system should display a success alert with the message "Success Book is issued"
    And the book should be added to the list with the reader "John Doe", book name "JavaScript Essentials", and genre "Programming"

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Attempt to add a book with a very long book name
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Add a book to the library list

  Scenario: [Edge] Attempt to add a book with a very long book name

    And the user enters "Jane Smith" into the username field with data-testid "user-name-input"
    And the user enters a very long book name "A Comprehensive Guide to Advanced JavaScript Programming Techniques and Best Practices" into the book name field with data-testid "book-name-input"
    And the user selects the "Fiction" radio button with data-testid "fiction-radio"
    When the user clicks the "Add Book" button with data-testid "add-book-button"
    Then the system should display a success alert with the message "Success Book is issued"
    And the book should be added to the list with the reader "Jane Smith", book name "A Comprehensive Guide to Advanced JavaScript Programming Techniques and Best Practices", and genre "Fiction"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Successfully deleting a book entry
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Deleting a Book Entry from the Library List
  The system should allow users to delete a book entry from the list and update the display accordingly.


  Scenario: [Normal] Successfully deleting a book entry
    Given the "Library Management System" page is loaded
    And the book list contains an entry with "userName" as "John Doe" and "bookName" as "JavaScript Basics"
    When the user clicks the "delete-button-0" associated with the first book entry
    Then the book entry with "userName" as "John Doe" and "bookName" as "JavaScript Basics" should be removed from the list
    And the display should be updated to reflect the removal

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Deleting the only book entry in the list
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Deleting a Book Entry from the Library List
  The system should allow users to delete a book entry from the list and update the display accordingly.


  Scenario: [Edge] Deleting the only book entry in the list
    Given the "Library Management System" page is loaded
    And the book list contains only one entry with "userName" as "Jane Smith" and "bookName" as "Python Programming"
    When the user clicks the "delete-button-0" associated with the only book entry
    Then the book list should be empty
    And the display should be updated to show no entries

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Display books from local storage on page load
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Display list of books from local storage on page load
  The system should display the list of books stored in local storage in the table body when the page loads.


  Scenario: [Normal] Display books from local storage on page load
    Given the local storage contains a list of books with at least one book entry
    When the user opens the Library Management System webpage
    Then the table body with data-testid "table-body" should display the list of books from local storage

reference_cases.title: [Edge] Display no books when local storage is empty
reference_cases.description:
